notes.title: AST-Hero Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello Pilots and Classic Shooter game fans!

We are proud to announce the release of our first game: [b]AST-Hero[/b] next month!

[u]Save the date[/u]: September 20, 2022!

[i]Our "ASTeroids" reboot is a space shooter where you can pilot your spaceship through the infinite space and must defeat waves of enemies leading to mighty bosses.[/i]

We have a discord event with more information in the description.

https://discord.gg/kZNwkggM?event=1011588502271574067

We'll be running a mini-game on this discord where you can win great stuff!

[url=https://discord.gg/3zVD3PM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978678/0765332b155586b5bb53d29bfac77f30aecacfc7.png[/img][/url]


Wishing you a fantastic week.
